comparison.objective: Seat a click-type torque wrench on a busbar-lug bolt, tighten to the click without over-torquing, then release.
comparison.physical_skill: Socket-to-hex alignment, tool grasping, controlled rotational force, and stopping on a one-shot break-over cue.
comparison.success_condition: Socket seated; click occurs at 90–110% target torque; no unseated turning, reversal, or over-torque; wrench released and still.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests bimanual load sharing and selective many-body separation through apertures, not tool seating or torque-cue response. No comparison-critical rubric detail is missing.
